attributes.text: From a VNC viewer, Ctrl+Shift+Esc triggers 'Recent Apps' overview, Home acts as Home button, End acts as Power button, Esc acts as Back button, Ctrl+Alt+PageUp/Ctrl+Alt+PageDown change audio volume.
